scripts.ci: yarn generate:version && cross-env DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.ci.yml up -d --build --remove-orphans
scripts.dev: yarn generate:version && cross-env DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 MRE_VERSION=dev docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml up --build --remove-orphans
scripts.build: yarn generate:version && cross-env DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml build --no-cache
scripts.start: yarn generate:version && cross-env DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --remove-orphans --force-recreate
scripts.clean:all: yarn workspaces foreach -A dlx rimraf node_modules .next
scripts.tsc: yarn workspaces foreach -A -ptv --exclude microrealestate run tsc
